Hi Jordan,

Thanks for walking us through the onboarding checklist this morning. We are ready to provide the W-8BEN-E and the bank confirmation, but I need one quick clarification before I sign: on your side you asked for a letter confirming the individual authorized to sign for payments — do you require a corporate board resolution or will a simple signed authorization on company letterhead suffice? Our legal team prefers to avoid board minutes unless strictly required.

Also, can you confirm the exact legal name Redwood will list on the PO? We have a couple of DBA variants and want to make sure the vendor name matches your AP system to avoid payment delays.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: W-8BEN-E and signatory details for Redwood PO

Hi Maria — thanks for the quick follow-up. Short answers below and next steps at the bottom.

1) Signatory evidence: A signed authorization on company letterhead is sufficient for our AP intake team for non-complex suppliers. We only escalate to a board resolution when the entity structure is non-standard or the signatory is not on file. Please include the signer's printed name, title and a scanned photo ID if possible — that expedites verification.

2) Legal name to appear on the PO: "Aurelia Systems, Inc." — please confirm that matches your W-8BEN-E entity name (line 1). If you transact under a DBA, add the DBA in parentheses on line 1 to match our records.

3) Withholding / treaty claim: If you are claiming treaty benefits, please fill out Part III (claim of tax treaty benefit) and attach a short explanation of the permanent establishment status. If not, leave Part III blank and our tax team will apply default nonresident withholding rules.

Next steps for an expedited PO:
- Return signed W-8BEN-E (PDF or DocuSign).
- Attach the authorization on company letterhead with signer name/title + photo ID.
- Optional but recommended: bank confirmation letter (on bank letterhead) showing account name and routing details for ACH.

We can issue a provisional PO once the signed W-8 is received and we have verified the signatory. Laura will confirm when AP can convert provisional to final PO and route to payments. I've attached a sample authorization template and a DocuSign link if you prefer e-sign.

Thanks — cc'd Kimberly and Laura so they have visibility.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Manager, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference

Please let us know if AP needs anything else to move from provisional PO to a final PO. We have a target go-live for the integration on March 22 so any hold-up on the PO will impact timelines.

Thanks again — Maria
